candidates.explanation: The size check uses `<` instead of `>`. It throws 413 when fileSize is less than file.maxFileSize, so a small 200 KB file is rejected. A 20 MB file passes, which only works if it is at or above the limit. Oversized files are therefore accepted and undersized ones rejected.

fix.description: Reverse the comparison so it throws only when fileSize exceeds the max. Also skip the check when the limit is not configured, because `|| 0` would otherwise reject every file.
